name: Al-Noor Islamic Centre
note: Weekly new-Muslim circle on Saturday afternoons. Ask at the desk for the reverts' coordinator — they will walk you through your first visit.

name: Masjid As-Salam
note: Very welcoming to visitors. English-language khutbah on Fridays. No formal class, but the imam is happy to meet new Muslims one-to-one.

name: Ar-Rahma Masjid & Community Hub
note: Runs a structured 'New Muslim Foundations' course each term and a monthly reverts' social. Sisters' section has its own entrance and coordinator.

name: Al-Huda Mosque
note: Traditional neighbourhood mosque, primarily for daily prayers. Limited English support — better as a place to pray than to learn as a beginner.

name: At-Taqwa Islamic Centre
note: Dedicated new-Muslim mentoring: they pair you with an experienced member for your first months. Free shahada support and documentation.

name: Madina Masjid
note: Busy central mosque with a helpful front desk. Good for finding congregational prayers and Ramadan iftars; ask about their reverts' WhatsApp group.
